dedupe_keys.name: adaline photovoltaic mppt controllers trained with rtrl and lms

description: This resource publishes an ADALINE neural controller for maximum-power-point tracking in an off-grid photovoltaic system. The research team supplies MATLAB implementations of RTRL and LMS training and C code for a PIC18F2550 experimental controller. Thirty-five CSV result tables and supporting files accompany the code in Mendeley, free under CC BY 4.0. The article describes five computational test cases and outdoor experiments, comparing the neural controllers with perturb-and-observe control. Coverage is one photovoltaic control design, not a geographic power network or continuous monitoring period. MATLAB/Simulink R2017a and the embedded hardware environment are limitations for present-day reproduction. A reviewer-assessed use is testing converter-control dynamics and training sensitivity in photovoltaic digital-twin simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related system-level PV modelling resource, without verified controller integration. The record covers the code and its accompanying calibration results together. No program, controller firmware or experimental dataset was downloaded or executed.
